newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso not revalued much since crash - Mancera.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso not revalued much since crash - Mancera.

text.p: Mexican Central Bank President Miguel Mancera said Friday that Mexico's exchange rate in real terms has not revalued significantly since the drastic peso devaluations of December 1994 and the following year.
The comment was included in the text of a speech to be delivered at the annual Mexican Bankers Convention that was made available to reporters.

"This phenomenon added to moderate wage rises has determined that the real exchange rate, measured on the basis of unit costs for labor, has not revalued in a significant way since the great depreciation that occured as a result of the devaluations of 1994 and 1995," Mancera's speech said.
